legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of HMT Korea wholesale and export storefront services, including browsing, ordering, and buyer inquiries.
legal.termsScopeBody: This agreement defines rights and responsibilities between HMT Korea and users of this storefront.
legal.termsServicesBody: You can sign up without a number. Register a business number or submit business evidence to automatically enable prices.
legal.termsAccountsBody: Users are responsible for accurate registration details and account security.
legal.termsOrdersBody: Buyers request a quote with product quantities. Orders are confirmed after review and inventory checks. Payment is by bank transfer. International shipping and customs fees may apply separately.
legal.privacyIntro: HMT Korea collects account, inquiry, and order information only to operate this wholesale storefront and respond to buyer requests.
legal.privacyUseBody: Contact details submitted through signup, wholesale inquiry, or orders are used to process requests and communicate about catalog, shipping, or account matters. We do not sell this information.
legal.privacyContactBody: For privacy questions, use the contact details on the Contact page or submit a wholesale inquiry.

supportDesign.shipping1Body: Tell us your appointed forwarder, destination country, and agreed receiving or loading location.
supportDesign.shipping2Body: International freight is arranged by the buyer. Product prices exclude freight; any costs within the agreed handover scope are confirmed before ordering.
supportDesign.shipping3Body: Availability and lead time are confirmed by our team. Product selection, quantities, and packing requirements can affect the preparation schedule.
supportDesign.shipping4Body: After order and payment confirmation, we prepare goods for handover to your appointed carrier at the agreed location.
supportDesign.payment1Body: Approved business buyers can add products to the quote list in the displayed MOQ units. The minimum product order value is USD {amount}; freight is charged separately.
supportDesign.payment2Body: Download Excel and PDF documents from your quote list to review product details, quantities, and prices. These documents are drafts until our team confirms the order.
supportDesign.payment3Body: Our team confirms availability, product pricing, freight, and trade terms. Use the final invoice as your reference for the agreed order and bank transfer details.
supportDesign.payment4Body: Payment is by bank transfer after quotation confirmation. Include the quotation or invoice reference so our team can identify your payment.
supportDesign.returns1Body: Keep the shipment packaging and record the quotation or invoice reference, product names, quantities, and the date you received the goods.
supportDesign.returns2Body: Send clear photos of the outer packaging, shipping label, and affected products through the contact details on this site.
supportDesign.returns3Body: Explain whether the delivery was damaged or contained incorrect goods. Our team reviews wholesale export cases individually against the confirmed order.
supportDesign.returns4Body: Contact our team before sending any goods back. Any return or exchange arrangement must be confirmed for the specific shipment.
supportDesign.faqApprovalQuestion: Why can I not see Supply Price after signing up?
supportDesign.faqApprovalAnswer: Register your business details and verify your email. Supply Price, quote actions, and invoice downloads become available after an administrator approves your business account.
supportDesign.faqMinimumQuestion: What is the minimum order amount?
supportDesign.faqMinimumAnswer: The minimum product order value is USD {amount}. Each product also has its own MOQ. Shipping is charged separately.
supportDesign.faqInvoiceQuestion: Can I download product details in Excel and PDF?
supportDesign.faqInvoiceAnswer: Yes. Approved business accounts can download a draft invoice from the quote list in Excel and PDF. Our team confirms availability, freight, and the final invoice separately.
supportDesign.faqPaymentAnswer: Submit a quote request first. After our team confirms the order, use the bank transfer details on the final invoice.
supportDesign.faqExistingQuestion: I already have an account. Do I need to register again?
supportDesign.faqExistingAnswer: Use your existing account. If business approval is pending, contact our team with your company details. An administrator can review and approve the existing account.
